verdict.rationale: Mercury's send-money docs state you can pay recipients over ACH, check, domestic wire and international wire, with optional approval controls, from both the dashboard and the API. Bill pay that reads bills and remembers past recipients covers the vendor-payment flow. A five-year customer independently reports that wire transfers work reliably. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on domestic ACH/wire limits, fees and settlement timing, and independent corroboration of ACH vendor payments specifically.
